infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) uses the camera to take a photo of users for their profiles.
infoPlist.NSLocationUsageDescription: $(PRODUCT_NAME) requires user's location in order to estimate the distance between other users, and provide geographically relevant content that are in users near proximity. For example Maria living in Paris will only need to see other profiles and books that are also in Paris or near Paris.

plugins.cameraPermission: $(PRODUCT_NAME) requires camera  take a photo for user profile, and/or optionally to take a photo of a book that users choose to manually add to their virtual book shelves.

plugins.photosPermission: $(PRODUCT_NAME) accesses your photos to assign a profile photo, and/or optionally to select a photo of a book that users choose to manually add to their virtual book shelves.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: $(PRODUCT_NAME) requires your approximate location to estimate the distance between you and other users, and provide geographically relevant content nearby you.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: $(PRODUCT_NAME) requires your approximate location to estimate the distance between you and other users, and provide geographically relevant content nearby you.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: $(PRODUCT_NAME) requires your approximate location to estimate the distance between you and other users, and provide geographically relevant content nearby you.
